raw.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
raw.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move.

As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better.

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs.

What you will do

  • Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends.

  • Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners.

  • Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly.

  • Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on.

  • Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production.

  • Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback.

  • Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might

  • Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails.

  • Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes.

  • Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own.

  • Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you.

  • A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must.

  • You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Head of IT and Security
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN US Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As our Head of IT & Security in Munich, you will own IT and security across all of our sites: reliable systems so our people can work quickly, protection for one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe, and the evidence that our controls work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Lead and grow our IT Operations and Security team, and own the roadmap and budget. Run helpdesk, devices, identity, networks and business systems, including ERP. Set one service standard across sites, including for IT onboarding and offboarding. Keep security assurance separate from IT delivery. Report security risks, service performance and remediation progress to leadership using live system data. Own the ISMS, security policies, incident response and business continuity. Assign owners to security alerts and drive vulnerability remediation, including patching, through verified closure. Take accountability for NIS2 compliance and the path to ISO 27001 certification, with evidence ready for audits and due diligence. Get the full value from Google Workspace Enterprise, GCP and our security tools, and enforce device management, endpoint protection, SSO, MFA and access controls. Set physical security standards for site access, cameras, visitors, monitoring and escalation. Bring in specialist expertise early to assess site risks and verify controls through commissioning. Own the cyber configuration, identity integration and security logging of connected access-control and camera systems. Define and verify security controls for lab, test-data and operational technology systems, with clear handling of exceptions. Manage our IT and security partners, contracts, service levels and licences, and match spend to what we use and need. WHO YOU ARE You have built and led IT or security across multiple sites or countries in a growing technology, engineering or industrial company, and can lead both disciplines. You have owned an ISMS and led ISO 27001 certification or a comparable security compliance programme. You have hands-on depth in Google Workspace, identity and device management, endpoint security, SIEM and networks, and can review a firewall rule or access policy yourself. You turn security risks, digital and physical, into practical controls and check that they work. You have managed teams, budgets and partners against clear priorities and measurable outcomes. Nice to have Experience with Google SecOps or another Google-centric security stack. Experience implementing NIS2 requirements. Experience with ERP, lab, test-data or operational technology systems. Experience in a startup, scale-up, regulated or high-security environment. German. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-45 min) Technical Screening (60 min) Panel Interviews (3x60 min) CEO call (30 min) This role sits at L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. title: Property Acquisition and Management Specialist (w/m/d)
description: ZEAL Network SE ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe und Deutschlands führender Anbieter von Online-Lotterien mit den Marken LOTTO24 und Tipp24. Gemeinsam mit Partnern wie ONCE sowie innovativen Angeboten wie Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung und ZEAL Ventures gestalten wir die Zukunft digitaler Lotterien und investieren in neue Geschäftsmodelle. Unser vielfältiges Team aus über 350 Mitarbeitenden verbindet Innovationsgeist, Zusammenarbeit und das gemeinsame Ziel, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ihre Träume zu verwirklichen. Deine Mission: Als House Sourcing & Management Specialist (w/m/d) ist es deine Aufgabe, regelmäßig einzigartige Immobilien für unsere Traumhausverlosung zu entdecken, die unsere Teilnehmer:innen begeistern. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Quadratmeter, sondern um das Besondere, das Außergewöhnliche – um Häuser zum Träumen, eben echte Traumhäuser. Deine Aufgaben: Du spürst besondere Bestandsimmobilien auf, die sich perfekt für unsere Verlosungen eignen. Du baust Beziehungen zu Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen und anderen relevanten Ansprechpartner:innen auf und pflegst diese. Ziel ist es, kreative und unkonventionelle Wege zum Erwerb attraktiver Immobilien zu finden. Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess von der ersten Besichtigung bis zur Übergabe an unsere Gewinner:innen und kümmerst dich um alle dazwischenliegenden Schritte. Du führst die Kaufverhandlungen und stellst sicher, dass alle Verträge fair sind und den erforderlichen Standards entsprechen. Du koordinierst externe Partner:innen wie Gutachter:innen, Handwerker:innen und weitere Fachkräfte, die uns bei der Vorbereitung der Immobilien für die Verlosung unterstützen. Du organisierst die administrative Übergabe der Häuser an unsere Gewinner:innen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Du betreust unser Immobilienportfolio vom Ankauf bis zur Übergabe an die Gewinner:innen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Versorgungsunternehmen und Versicherungen, veranlasst notwendige Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen, behältst Verträge, Fristen und laufende Kosten im Blick und stellst sicher, dass alle Immobilien gepflegt und ausreichend versichert sind. Was du mitbringst: Du bringst langjährige Erfahrung im privaten Wohnimmobilienbereich mit, hast Immobilientransaktionen eigenständig gesteuert und verantwortet und kannst erfolgreich abgeschlossene Transaktionen der vergangenen Jahre nachweisen. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der Immobilien- und Hauspreise sowohl deutschlandweit als auch in unseren jeweiligen Zielregionen und kannst Preisvorstellungen kritisch hinterfragen. Idealerweise bringst du zudem Maklererfahrung in Zweitwohnsitzmärkten und Ferienregionen außerhalb Deutschlands mit. Du besitzt ein sehr gutes analytisches Verständnis, ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken und starkes Verhandlungsgeschick. Du erkennst sofort, was eine Immobilie einzigartig macht, und weißt, wie du sie für Fotos oder Besichtigungen perfekt in Szene setzt, um einen echten Wow-Effekt zu erzielen. Du kannst professionelle Netzwerke aufbauen und Projekte von Anfang bis Ende planen und umsetzen. Du verstehst, was Menschen sich von einem Zuhause wünschen, und findest Immobilien, die diese Wünsche erfüllen. Du bist ein echtes Networking-Talent und pflegst Kontakte zu potenziellen Immobilienverkäufer:innen ebenso souverän wie zu Makler:innen oder Gutachter:innen. Du arbeitest eigenständig und bringst Reisebereitschaft mit, um die besten Immobilien für uns zu finden. Du hast eine ausgeprägte Owner-Mentalität und packst gerne selbst mit an. Du scheust dich nicht davor, neue Ideen umzusetzen oder unkonventionelle Wege zu gehen. Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. What we offer you: A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany. Monthly company events, team activities, and informal gatherings, including our popular company-wide lunches provided four days a week. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Kontinuierliche persönliche Weiterentwicklung, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 €, das du in deine berufliche Entwicklung investieren kannst. Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung – kein Mikromanagement, sondern echtes Vertrauen in deine Fähigkeiten, hervorragende Ergebnisse zu liefern. Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, das auf Resultate fokussiert ist. Unbegrenzte Urlaubstage zusätzlich zu deinem regulären Urlaubsanspruch von 30 Tagen pro Jahr. Möglichkeit zu Workations im Ausland über unser WorkFlex-Tool. Monatlicher Mobilitätszuschuss von 30 €, den du für das Verkehrsmittel deiner Wahl nutzen kannst (z. B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft. Geförderte EGYM WELLPASS-Mitgliedschaft – du zahlst nur 25 € pro Monat und erhältst Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios und Sportangeboten in ganz Deutschland. Monatliche Firmenevents sowie regelmäßige Teamaktivitäten und informelle Treffen – besonders beliebt: unsere kostenlose Lunches von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro! title: Senior Business Security Consultant
description: About Northwave Defending the digital frontier is our mission. At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium. Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey. By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact. Your Mission As a Senior Business Security Consultant , you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value. Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization. Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives. As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs. In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole. What You Enjoy Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies. Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps. Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions. Providing guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to colleagues within project teams while actively promoting knowledge sharing across the organization. Facilitating workshops, executive presentations, and strategic decision-making processes at management and board level. Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities. Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients. Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice. What you can expect from us First things first: You will get 30 days' holiday per year and we contribute a minimum of 20% to your company pension plan (bAV). You can organise your own working hours in consultation with your colleagues and customers. A mobility budget , also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances. What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave. It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities , such as a trip to the theme park. You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone . We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-) what else... No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles? Consulting Expertise: You bring extensive experience in cybersecurity and/or management consulting and have successfully managed complex transformation and advisory projects in client-facing environments. Trusted Advisor Mindset: You are comfortable challenging and advising executive stakeholders, earning credibility quickly and acting as a trusted advisor throughout strategic decision-making processes. Commercial Awareness: You combine a strong consulting mindset with commercial acumen, helping to identify opportunities, shape client engagements, and support business growth initiatives. Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English is required. Interested? If you are still not sure, see what Working at Northwave looks like. And when you are ready to come on board, we are looking forward to your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Business Performance Analyst (all genders)
description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.   Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken. Deine Mission bei Foodji Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams. Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen. Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick. Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum. Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten. Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen. AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. Das bringst du mit 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln. Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt. Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München. UNSERE BENEFITS Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Interface Cutover Lead (Freelance)
description: Mandatory Expertise – Bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen Für ein langfristiges SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramm bei einem großen deutschen Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior SAP Interface Cutover Lead. Im Rahmen der Transformation von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA müssen rund 800 Schnittstellen zwischen SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen koordiniert und im Zuge des Cutovers in die neue Systemlandschaft überführt werden. Ein Großteil der erforderlichen technischen Anpassungen wurde bereits umgesetzt. Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Experte, der den gesamten Schnittstellen-Workstream im Cutover eigenverantwortlich plant, koordiniert und steuert. Drei zwingende Anforderungen: SAP Interface Cutover Management: Nachweisbare persönliche Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung eines schnittstellenbezogenen Cutovers innerhalb komplexer SAP-Transformations-, Migrations- oder Carve-out-Projekte. Technisches Schnittstellenverständnis: Fundiertes Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Integrationen, Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Middleware-Technologien sowie der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung und Validierung von Schnittstellen. Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung: Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Teams, externer Dienstleister und verschiedener Stakeholder innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme. Es handelt sich nicht um eine reine SAP-Cutover-Management-Rolle, eine klassische Datenmigrationsrolle oder eine Schnittstellenentwicklerposition. Entscheidend ist die Kombination aus Cutover Management, technischer Integrationskompetenz und eigenverantwortlicher Workstream-Steuerung. Bitte bewirb Dich nur, wenn Du konkrete Projektreferenzen in diesem Umfeld vorweisen kannst. Rahmenbedingungen Start: ASAP Laufzeit: bis Ende März 2028 Auslastung: 100 % Einsatzort: 80 % remote, 20 % Frankfurt am Main Sprache: sehr gutes Deutsch Level: Senior / Lead Vertragsart: Freelance / B2B Bevorzugt Experten mit Standort in Deutschland Tasks Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuerung des Interface Cutover innerhalb eines komplexen SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramms. Erstellung, Pflege und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines detaillierten Cutover-Plans für rund 800 SAP- und Non-SAP-Schnittstellen. Enge Abstimmung des Interface-Cutover-Plans mit dem übergeordneten Cutover Management und weiteren relevanten Workstreams. Identifikation und Bewertung technischer und fachlicher Abhängigkeiten zwischen Schnittstellen, Anwendungen und Systemen. Definition und Abstimmung der notwendigen Umschaltsequenzen und Cutover-Aktivitäten. Koordination der beteiligten SAP-, Integrations-, Non-SAP-, Infrastruktur- und Betriebsteams sowie externer Dienstleister. Sicherstellung der technischen und organisatorischen Readiness aller relevanten Schnittstellen. Planung und Koordination der schnittstellenbezogenen Aktivitäten im Rahmen von Cutover-Rehearsals und produktiven Cutover-Phasen. Steuerung der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung, Validierung und des kontrollierten Wiederanlaufs von Schnittstellen. Identifikation, Bewertung und proaktive Steuerung von Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und kritischen Pfaden. Entwicklung und Abstimmung geeigneter Fallback-, Recovery- und Eskalationsszenarien. Überwachung des Fortschritts, strukturierte Statuskommunikation und Eskalation kritischer Themen an das übergeordnete Cutover Management. Koordination der Schnittstellenaktivitäten während des Go-live sowie Unterstützung der anschließenden Stabilisierung und Hypercare-Phase. Requirements Langjährige Erfahrung in komplexen SAP-Transformations-, Migrations-, Integrations- oder Carve-out-Projekten. Nachweisbare Erfahrung als SAP Interface Cutover Lead, Integration Cutover Manager, Interface Coordinator oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit konkreter Schnittstellenverantwortung während des Cutovers. Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA-Transformationen, idealerweise bei Migrationen von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA. Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Erstellung und Steuerung komplexer Cutover-Pläne. Fundiertes technisches Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Schnittstellen sowie systemübergreifenden Integrationsarchitekturen. Gute Kenntnisse relevanter Schnittstellentechnologien wie IDoc, RFC, APIs, Web Services und File-based Interfaces. Erfahrung mit Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Umschaltsequenzen, technischen Tests und kontrollierten Produktivsetzungen. Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer technischer Teams und externer Implementierungspartner. Ausgeprägtes Risiko-, Eskalations- und Stakeholdermanagement. Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte strukturiert aufzubereiten und Entscheidungen mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern herbeizuführen. Selbstständige, analytische, hypothesenorientierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Terminen in Frankfurt am Main. Nice-to-haves Erfahrung mit SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite / CPI oder vergleichbaren Middleware-Technologien. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities. AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows. Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access. 2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls. Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly. Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor. 3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection. Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function. Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter. DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting. Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets. Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors. 4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team. Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines. Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board. 12-Month Success Metrics: Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company. Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert. Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks. AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks. Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks. FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR). Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains. Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Drive Applied AI Research & Model Development 

  • Research, develop, train, and fine-tune machine learning and LLM models to solve complex challenges within the manufacturing and product sustainability domain. 

  • Explore and evaluate new AI/ML methodologies, translating research and experimentation into practical, scalable solutions. 

  • Develop and optimise manufacturing, and compositional models to advance Makersite's core AI capabilities. 

Data Extraction & Pipeline Development 

  • Extract, consolidate, process, and contextualise complex data from customer ERP, PLM, and third-party databases to support AI model development. 

  • Design robust, reproducible, and extensible data pipelines to support model training, evaluation, and delivery. 

  • Address data quality, gaps, and complexity across both standardised and customer-specific AI use cases. 

Translate Research into Production 

  • Take AI research and experimentation through to production-ready solutions, collaborating with engineering and product teams to integrate models into Makersite's platform. 

  • Evaluate model performance and drive iterative improvements in accuracy, scalability, and practical application. 

Advance Makersite's AI Strategy 

  • Contribute to the evolution of Makersite's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to improve existing models, processes, and capabilities. 

  • Research emerging AI approaches and propose improvements to our AI stack and model development practices. 

Collaborate & Provide Technical Leadership 

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions. 

  • Share research findings and provide technical guidance, taking ownership of complex problems from exploration through to delivery. 


  • 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI research, or a related field. 

  • Research-oriented background in AI/ML, with demonstrable research contributions such as publications or technical papers. 

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and optimising ML models and LLMs. 

  • Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Pandas. 

  • Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions from research and experimentation through to production-level delivery. 

  • Strong understanding of data extraction, processing, and pipeline development for AI/ML model training. 

  • Manufacturing domain knowledge and experience working with complex B2B or enterprise datasets. 

  • Experience collaborating within AI/ML teams and with cross-functional stakeholders. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in Germany or the UK. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience working with ERP, PLM, manufacturing, supply chain, or sector-specific databases. 

  • Experience developing customer-specific AI models and taking AI products or solutions to market. 

  • Experience contributing to AI strategy or the development of AI capabilities within an organisation. 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, or sustainability. 

Key Attributes 

  • Research-driven and naturally curious, with a passion for exploring and developing new AI approaches. 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex, ambiguous challenges. 

  • Ownership-driven, entrepreneurial, and focused on delivering outcomes. 

  • Pragmatic, balancing research and innovation with business constraints and real-world application. 

  • Strong communicator and collaborator, able to share insights and work effectively across teams. 

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change first, we'd like to hear from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You will work as a full member of the AI Core team, supporting the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. The team's core product is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): we keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations, and ensure every company in the group has a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and ship it to every company in the portfolio. Each company owns and administers their own Hub (L1 Support). The AI Core team drives the features, changes, and integrations that create value across all hubs and serves as the centre of expertise (L2 Support) when local teams need guidance or hands-on help.

You will have direct ownership of tasks, contribute your own ideas, and actively shape how the platform evolves. This is not an observation role, you will work on the same codebase and infrastructure as the rest of the team.

What You Will Work On

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain shared AI Hub instances across Azure and AWS
  • Build and test platform tools, functions, and custom AI agents based on specifications
  • Monitor platform health, uptime, logs, and configuration consistency across all deployed AI Hub instances
  • Build health-check, alerting, and reporting scripts that track version parity, uptime, cloud usage, and deployment status
  • Support containerized application deployment, environment configuration, secrets handling, and rollback processes
  • Implement and validate integrations with infrastructure and enterprise services such as MCP servers, Git/Bitbucket, Microsoft Graph, and data providers
  • Write deployment guides, runbooks, and onboarding documentation for new companies joining the platform
  • Monitor core platform and dependency releases, then summarize operational impact, upgrade steps, and risks for the group

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Strong Python skills, comfortable writing scripts, calling APIs, and building small applications
  • Comfortable with Bash/shell scripting and working in a Linux terminal
  • Basic familiarity with cloud infrastructure and application deployment on Azure or AWS
  • Practical experience using LLMs via API (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and deployment workflows
  • Ability to read and work from technical documentation independently
  • Strong written communication in English (fluent) and German (fluent)

Bonus

  • Cloud platform certifications in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud are a plus, especially when paired with hands-on deployment or operations experience
  • Experience with cloud application platforms, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agentic AI frameworks
  • Infrastructure as Code awareness (Bicep, Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with authentication concepts (OAuth, SSO, JWT)
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, or cloud operations tools such as Azure Monitor or CloudWatch

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • Work on infrastructure and tooling that directly shapes how 55+ software companies adopt AI, your output has immediate, visible impact across the group
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • Full integration into the AI Core team, contributing alongside senior engineers from day one, with a direct line to the CTO office
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise AI infrastructure across Azure and AWS in production
  • Access to enterprise AI tooling: Claude Code, Azure OpenAI, and a modern multi-cloud AI platform stack
  • Direct ownership of tasks with measurable impact, not support work or observation
  • Active investment in your development: mentorship from the AI Core team, exposure to real architecture decisions, and access to relevant events and conferences

How to Apply

Send your CV along with a brief note on why this role interests you and what you would bring to the AI Core team. No formal cover letter required.

We are looking forward to your application!

description: Starte bei Symporo durch und unterstütze uns dabei, Daten in aussagekräftige Reports und Dashboards zu verwandeln. Worum es geht Die Symporo Gruppe vereint 13 regionale Catering-Marken mit über 1.400 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten. Jeden Tag bereiten wir mehr als 100.000 Mahlzeiten für Kitas, Schulen, Senioren und Unternehmen zu. Jede Marke arbeitet heute mit eigenen Systemen, Webseiten und Abläufen. Deshalb bauen wir eine eigene, gemeinsame Plattform für die ganze Gruppe. Sie reicht vom Webshop, über den Eltern, Schulen und Senioren bestellen, über Speisepläne, Rezepte und Küche bis zu Einkauf, Lager und Lieferung. Ein erfahrenes, internationales Entwicklungsteam setzt die Plattform um. Das Projekt läuft über mehr als zwei Jahre, und wir führen es Unternehmen für Unternehmen ein. Ein großer Teil der Arbeit liegt in der Veränderung der täglichen Abläufe. Die Gruppe wächst weiter, und jedes neue Unternehmen kommt ebenfalls auf die Plattform. Wir suchen die Person, die dieses Projekt im Alltag zusammenhält: zwischen unseren Unternehmen und dem Entwicklungsteam. Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst die Einführung der Plattform in unseren Unternehmen: Zeitpläne, Aufgaben, Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte. Du bist die Brücke zwischen unseren Unternehmen und dem Entwicklungsteam und trägst Verantwortung auf beiden Seiten. Auf Seiten der Unternehmen lernst du die Abläufe in unseren Küchen, in der Bestellannahme, Tourenplanung und Buchhaltung kennen. Du sprichst mit den Teams vor Ort auf Deutsch und übersetzt das Gelernte in klare Produktanforderungen. Du begleitest jedes Team durch die Veränderung im Arbeitsalltag, damit die neuen Abläufe nach dem Start Bestand haben. Auf Seiten der Entwicklung arbeitest du täglich auf Englisch mit dem Team: Du priorisierst das Backlog, beantwortest Rückfragen schnell, erklärst, wie unser Betrieb funktioniert, und nimmst neue Funktionen ab. Du organisierst Tests mit den Teams vor Ort, die Übernahme von Daten (Kunden, Speisepläne, Preise) und Schulungen. Du schulst Key User, die danach ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterstützen. Rund um jeden Start und während der Schulungen bist du länger vor Ort. Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands sind ein großer Teil dieser Rolle. Du stimmst jeden Start mit unserem E-Commerce & Content Specialist ab: Inhalte der Webseite, Zeitpunkt des Starts und Kommunikation an unsere Kunden. Du bringst neu hinzugekommene Unternehmen auf die Plattform. Du hältst Geschäftsführungen und Lenkungskreis auf dem Laufenden: Fortschritt, Risiken und anstehende Entscheidungen. Du dokumentierst Abläufe, Entscheidungen und Anleitungen so, dass andere damit arbeiten können. Das bringst du mit 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb und IT. Idealerweise Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Catering oder Lebensmittelproduktion. Eine Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in der Küche ist ein klarer Pluspunkt. Erfahrung darin, neue Systeme oder Abläufe in operativen Teams einzuführen. Grundwissen im IT-Produktmanagement: Du weißt, was eine User Story, ein Release und ein Test sind, und hast mit Jira, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Tools gearbeitet. Du sprichst mit einem Koch in der Küche genauso sicher wie mit einem Entwickler im Videocall. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Du arbeitest jeden Tag in beiden Sprachen: auf Deutsch mit unseren Unternehmen, auf Englisch mit dem Entwicklungsteam. Du bleibst ruhig und strukturiert, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag. Erfahrung mit Daten und Reporting, zum Beispiel in Excel oder SQL, ist ein Plus. Bereitschaft zu häufigen Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands, auch für mehrere Tage am Stück. Führerschein Klasse B. Warum diese Rolle Du baust ein System mit auf, das jeden Tag tausende Mahlzeiten betrifft. Du bist von Anfang an dabei, hast kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit in den Küchen verändert. Wenn die Plattform steht, wächst die Rolle mit der Gruppe, zum Beispiel in die Integration neuer Unternehmen oder in Konzernberichte und Dashboards. Weiterbildung in Daten- und BI-Tools unterstützen wir. Bewerbung Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum dich diese Rolle reizt, mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühesten Eintrittstermins. title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.   This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.  You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.  You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will:   Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations. Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry. Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc. Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use. Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers. Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs. Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles. Work in multiple levels of the technology stack. Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails. Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity. Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management. Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations. Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems. Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems. Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages. An ideal candidate also has: MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language. Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs. Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications. Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.). Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles. Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working  At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations  Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
