raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it.

  • Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar

  • Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks

  • Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these

  • Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing AI agents, backend and frontend, infrastructure, etc.

  • Bring strong, pragmatic engineering instincts and care about code that holds up in production at enterprise scale

We hire the best, wherever they come from: we sponsor visas and are based in London. We believe diverse teams build better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What You'll Own

We don’t box people by background or role: if you have a strength in an area, we’d love for you to contribute. This means everything from writing developing our connector in ABAP, developing AI agents that execute ABAP development tasks, to contributing to product direction and implementation.

You'll speak to customers, shape product direction, and ship things that run inside some of the most complex enterprise environments in the world. As an SAP specialist you’ll catch the edge cases, constraints, and quirks that only someone with that experience would spot.

Our Stack

Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we’re sure you'll pick it up fast. Here’s our setup:

  • ABAP: Custom reports to integrate ABAP-based systems with the Conduct platform

  • React, Vite, TanStack frontend

  • Kotlin backend: Modern and expressive, paired with the maturity, tooling, and depth of the Java ecosystem. Lets us ship fast now without painting ourselves into a corner later.

  • Temporal and PortKey: Absorbs infrastructure complexity around durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing, so we can focus on shipping instead.

  • Specialised LLM Harness: Built from hard-earned experience to give agents maximum freedom and intelligence without compromising on enterprise control, governance, or reliability.

raw.title: Performance Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Our Purpose

 

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

About this role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to lead and evolve our performance marketing function across regions.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced performance marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing deep expertise in paid acquisition and a strong understanding of full-funnel growth in a B2B SaaS environment.

You will act as the central connector between brand, regional marketing, partnerships, and our external performance agency, ensuring performance marketing not only drives demand, but also improves conversion and contributes directly to pipeline and revenue.

You will be responsible for ensuring performance marketing effectively connects local brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU) through to conversion and revenue (MOFU/BOFU), adapting strategies to reflect market-specific dynamics, verticals, and customer behaviour across geographies.

 
 

How you’ll make an impact

Success in this role will come from building a scalable, insight-driven performance engine that drives measurable business growth across markets, within our ICP and target segments:

  • Driving pipeline and revenue growth through performance marketing across regions

  • Connecting brand, demand creation, and conversion into a cohesive full-funnel strategy

  • Ensuring performance marketing supports inbound, outbound and partner-led growth

  • Delivering locally relevant performance strategies that reflect market maturity and vertical focus

  • Improving conversion rates and efficiency across the funnel

  • Providing clear visibility into what is driving demand, conversion, and revenue across geographies

  • Strengthening collaboration between performance, brand, regional teams, and sales

 

What you’ll do

Performance Strategy & Planning

  • Define and execute a holistic performance marketing strategy aligned to business, regional and vertical priorities

  • Translate pipeline and revenue targets into channel strategies, budget allocation, and investment plans

  • Ensure a full-funnel approach across all geographies, connecting:

    • Brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU)

    • Consideration and engagement (MOFU)

    • Conversion and revenue generation (BOFU)

  • Identify and prioritise new growth opportunities across channels, audiences, and markets

 

Channel Performance & Optimisation

  • Own performance across all paid acquisition channels (e.g. search, social, display, affiliates)

  • Drive continuous testing and experimentation across targeting, creative, landing pages, and funnel

  • Optimise for end-to-end performance (traffic → lead → opportunity → revenue), not just lead volume

  • Ensure budget is allocated effectively based on performance, incrementality, and scalability

  • Adapt channel strategies to reflect local market context, verticals, and customer behaviour

 

Demand, Conversion & Insights

  • Own performance reporting and insights across:

    • Pipeline and revenue contribution

    • Conversion rates across funnel stages

    • Cost efficiency (CPL, CAC, LTV:CAC)

  • Provide clear, actionable insights to:

    • Regional marketing teams (what’s driving local demand)

    • Brand team (what messaging and creative is converting)

    • Sales and leadership (pipeline quality and opportunities)

  • Surface early signals on opportunities and risks across markets

  • Ensure clear visibility of how TOFU activity translates into MOFU/BOFU outcomes across geographies

 

Agency & Stakeholder Management

  • Own and lead the relationship with our global performance marketing agency, ensuring:

    • High-quality execution and optimisation

    • Strategic input and proactive recommendations

    • Clear accountability against KPIs

  • Ensure agency output reflects local market needs, not just global scale

  • Act as the key liaison between brand, regional teams, partnerships, RevOps and external partners

  • Align stakeholders on performance, priorities, and growth opportunities

 

Technology & Tracking

  • Ensure all paid channels are accurately tracked, measured, and integrated across systems (e.g. Salesforce, marketing automation)

  • Partner with RevOps and Data teams to improve attribution, tracking, and reporting infrastructure

  • Ensure full-funnel visibility across geographies, connecting campaign performance to revenue outcomes

Leadership

  • Set clear priorities, goals, and development plans

  • Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement

 

What you’ll bring with you

  • Experience: 7+ years experience in performance marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS

  • Strategic mindset: Strong ability to translate business goals into scalable performance strategies

  • Performance expertise: Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue growth through paid channels

  • Full-funnel understanding: Experience connecting brand, demand generation, and conversion (TOFU → MOFU → BOFU)

  • Multi-market experience: Experience adapting strategies across different geographies and market maturities

  • Collaboration: Skilled at influencing and aligning cross-functional teams (Sales, Brand, Partnerships, RevOps)

  • Data-driven: Confident in using data and insights to optimise performance and communicate impact

  • Agency management: Experience managing and scaling external agency relationships

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders

  • Tools: Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (SFMC/HubSpot), analytics and attribution tools

  • Mindset: Self-starter with strong ownership, adaptability, and curiosity to test and learn in a fast-paced environment

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

 

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

raw.description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the Role.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join Zilch’s Risk team, with a focus on developing and optimising advanced models in the Risk space, primarily across credit risk, with additional focus on collections optimisation and fraud detection. You will leverage diverse data sources to support key areas across the business, building production-grade models and decisioning solutions that improve risk outcomes, customer experience, and operational efficiency. This role will involve close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, risk strategy, credit, collections, fraud, and other data scientists, to ensure data-driven insights are successfully integrated into product strategies, risk decisioning, and business growth initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong applied machine learning with modern ML Ops practices. We are looking for a data scientist who can take models from exploration through to production, monitoring, and iteration.

Key Responsibilities.

  • Work with large and complex datasets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using various analytical and statistical approaches.

  • Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve millions of customers and thousands of merchants.

  • Build, validate, deploy, and monitor robust, scalable machine learning models and model pipelines across the risk lifecycle, including onboarding, affordability, life-time value, credit/default risk, in-life risk, collections, and fraud.

  • Present complex data science findings and methodologies to senior stakeholders clearly and concisely.

  • Apply machine learning methods to solve risk and product-related business problems and enhance our decision-making processes.

  • Contribute to the team’s coding efforts, ensuring best practices in version control, testing, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, methodologies, workflows, and tooling.

  • Conduct A/B testing, champion/challenger testing, and experimental analyses to evaluate new features, risk strategies, model changes, and product changes.

  • Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to operationalise models, automate workflows, and improve model reliability in production.

What We're Looking For.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data scientist, with a focus on building and deploying models to enhance the customer product experience, risk decisioning, and business outcomes, ideally within credit risk, collections, fraud, financial services, lending, payments, or another decision-intensive domain.

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python and core data science and machine learning libraries, such as NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-Learn.

  • Strong practical experience with machine learning model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production environments, including cloud-based model training, archiving, serving, endpoint deployment, and tools such as Amazon SageMaker or similar.

  • Experience communicating complex ideas to non-technical audiences and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning methods, their application in real-world scenarios and a keen awareness of their limitations.

  • A strong engineering mindset, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-ready code, use version control systems such as Git, and collaborate effectively in a multi-developer environment.

  • A results-driven approach, with the ability to quickly iterate and improve models in production.

  • Knowledge of AI safety considerations, such as bias detection, privacy management, and handling personally identifiable information (PII).

  • Familiarity with software development best practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, such as GitHub Actions.

  • Experience using DBT for data modelling and Looker for BI reporting.

  • An interest in staying up to date with evolving technologies and applying them to enhance business outcomes.

Nice to Have.

The following are bonuses rather than strict requirements. We do not expect candidates to have all of them:

  • Prior experience in credit risk modelling, collections optimisation, fraud detection, or risk strategy.

  • Familiarity with risk model governance, explainability, fairness, affordability, or regulatory considerations in financial services.

  • Experience with decision science, automated decisioning systems, decision engines, or risk strategy implementation.

  • Experience applying neural networks or deep learning approaches to practical risk, fraud, or decisioning problems.

Compensation & Savings:

  • Pension scheme.

  • Death in Service scheme.

  • Income Protection.

  • Permanent employees enjoy access to our Share Options Scheme.

  • 5% back on in-app purchases.

  • £200 for WFH Setup.

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Private Medical Insurance including;

  • GP consultations (video, telephone or face-to-face).

  • Prescribed medication.

  • In-patient, day-patient and out-patient care.

  • Mental health support.

  • Optical, dental & audiological cover.

  • Physiotherapy.

  • Advanced cancer cover.

    • Unlimited mental health sessions.

    • 24/7 remote GP & physiotherapy.

    • 24/7 helpline for emotional & practical support.

  • Savings & discounts on everyday shopping.

  • 1:1 personalised well-being consultations.

title: Responsable Technique SI Industriels & Réseaux de Transport - Métro  F/H
description: Notre client Tisséo Ingénierie (env 100p), conçoit et réalise les transports de demain de l’agglomération toulousaine. SPL de droit privé, la société pilote, en qualité de maître d’ouvrage délégué, les études et les travaux de projets d’envergure d’infrastructures de transport pour un territoire regroupant environ 100 communes et plus d’un million d’habitants. Ainsi, elle accompagne les collectivités de l’agglomération toulousaine dans leur programme ambitieux de projets mobilité, avec notamment la création d’une 3ème ligne de métro (Ligne C : 27 km – 3,1 Md€), la Connexion avec la Ligne B et des Pôles d’Echanges Multimodaux (PEM). Dans ce cadre, la Direction Systèmes d’Exploitation et d’Information renforce son équipe en recrutant un Responsable Technique SI Industriels & Réseaux de Transport - Métro Ligne C Toulouse   Au sein d’une équipe resserrée (4 pers), en appui du Chef de projet courants faibles, vous vous voyez confier un rôle clé dans le pilotage de la finalisation de la conception d’infrastructures d’hébergement, de réseaux de communication (télécommunication et radiocommunication) et de systèmes courants faibles (vidéosurveillance, contrôle d’accès, billettique, information voyageurs…) avant leur mise en œuvre sur le projet de la ligne C. Votre positionnement implique des interactions nombreuses tant en interne avec des Chefs de projets ou des Responsables techniques qu’en externe avec les équipes spécialisées de l’exploitant du réseau de transport, les interlocuteurs du Maitre d’ouvrage en charge de la gestion du patrimoine, le Maitre d’œuvre, des industriels ou des entreprises de travaux.   Au quotidien vous êtes amené(e) à : Piloter des marchés de prestations intellectuelles, de fournitures et/ou de travaux en veillant au respect des engagements contractuels, du planning, des coûts et de la qualité ; Contribuer à la mise au point des solutions techniques étudiées et à la cohérence de la conception entre les différents systèmes de supervision et de courants faibles ainsi qu’à leurs interfaces avec les autres systèmes déployés (système de transport, équipements connectés du second œuvre comme la ventilation tunnel et stations, les escaliers mécaniques, les ascenseurs…) ; Superviser la production d’études et de dossiers administratifs et en organiser leur revue ; Suivre la réalisation de travaux, d’essais et organiser leur réception ; Animer des réunions de coordination interne et d’avancement avec les partenaires et fournisseurs/prestataires mobilisés ; Apporter des conseils et un appui technique pour sécuriser les arbitrages ; Instruire sur le plan contractuel les travaux de modification ou d’évolution, émettre et formaliser des recommandations techniques, rédiger des notes ou produire des documents destinés aux instances du Maitre d’ouvrage ; Participer à la migration informatique des équipements et systèmes des stations de correspondance Lignes A et B avec la ligne C vers une supervision unique via le poste de commande centralisé de la ligne C. De formation ingénieur (informatique, électronique ou telecom), vous justifiez d’ au moins 5 ans d’expérience afin de posséder de solides compétences dans la conception et le déploiement de réseaux de communication et systèmes courants faibles, idéalement acquises dans un environnement transport. Habitué(e) aux projets complexes, vous êtes à l’aise dans des contextes multi-acteurs et comprenez les enjeux contractuels associés.   On vous reconnaît notamment pour : votre sens de la coordination et votre capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés votre aptitude à proposer des solutions et prendre position votre agilité et votre sens des responsabilités. title: Responsable Administratif et Financier F/H
description: Filiale du groupe familial indépendant SIFCOR (plus de 100 ans d'histoire), la société Forges de Courcelles conçoit et produit des pièces forgées et usinées de liaison, de moteur et de sécurité pour les plus grands constructeurs et équipementiers automobiles et poids lourds, mais aussi pour d’autres industries dans le cadre de sa stratégie de diversification.   Avec un effectif de 430 collaborateurs et un chiffre d'affaires de 170 M€, dont 61 % réalisé à l'export, la société poursuit ses investissements industriels pour assurer son développement, être à la pointe de la technologie dans ses métiers et accompagner ses clients dans les transformations industrielles ; elle est par ailleurs engagée dans une politique RSE volontariste. Son ambition : être un acteur majeur du développement industriel responsable européen. Le groupe SIFCOR (200 M€ - 90000 tonnes de métal transformé) regroupe également Stévenin-Nollevaux, SIFCOR D&A et Decomatic, et a construit des partenariats industriels en Inde et en Chine.   Rattaché(e) au Directeur Financier Groupe et en lien étroit avec le Responsable du Contrôle de Gestion Industriel, vous garantissez la fiabilité de l'information comptable et financière, la maîtrise des risques et la fluidité des processus. Votre périmètre est celui des Forges de Courcelles, avec des interventions ponctuelles dans d'autres sociétés du groupe.   Vos missions principales : •        Manager et fédérer l'équipe de 4 personnes : vous organisez, animez et coordonnez l’équipe dans un objectif d’efficience, assurez la montée en compétences pour répondre aux objectifs du service, accompagnez l’équipe dans les changements. •        Garantir la fiabilité comptable et piloter les clôtures financières : vous supervisez la production comptable, sécurisez les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles dans le respect des délais Groupe, en lien avec le Contrôle de Gestion et les Commissaires aux comptes. •        Superviser la trésorerie et sécuriser les flux financiers : vous veillez à l’optimisation du BFR, en lien avec les responsables opérationnels, le Contrôle de Gestion et nos partenaires financiers. •        Assurer la conformité fiscale et réglementaire, déployer et suivre le contrôle interne •        Accompagner la transformation digitale : vous fiabilisez et optimisez les processus financiers dans notre ERP en lien avec notre prestataire, avec pour objectif la simplification, l’automatisation et la dématérialisation. •        Superviser les affaires juridiques et administratives courantes (assemblées générales, formalités légales, délégations de pouvoirs…) et la gestion des risques contractuels et assurantiels. •        Contribuer à la gouvernance du groupe sur des projets transversaux (intégration de nouvelles entités, harmonisation des pratiques, transformation SI…). De formation supérieure BAC+3 minimum dans le domaine (finance, comptabilité, audit, gestion), vous avez des connaissances dans les processus de consolidation. Vous apportez une expérience solide en finance et comptabilité (intégrant la clôture des comptes), avec du management d’équipe ; la connaissance du secteur industriel dans un environnement exigeant sur le plan comptable et financier (idéalement dans l’industrie automobile) vous permettra de vous adapter rapidement ; vous avez travaillé avec un ERP (idéalement SAP) et maîtrisez excel. La pratique de l’anglais est un plus. Vos autres atouts :        capacité d’analyse, prise de recul et vision transversale, organisation, réactivité, souplesse et adaptabilité ;        capacités en management pour amener l’équipe vers le changement ;        qualités relationnelles, transparence et fiabilité.  Forges de Courcelles propose : CDI temps plein statut cadre au forfait jours, rémunération selon CCN et expérience (référence 70-80 k€), téléphone et ordinateur portables, accord d’intéressement, de participation, mutuelle, et régime d’épargne retraite prises en charge à 100%, CSE. title: Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager

The objective is to deliver a safe, repeatable and scalable process for the A2MAC1 Data Factory.  The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures.  As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to:  Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites.  Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery.  Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation.  Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites.  Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030.  RESPONSABILITIES  1. Process Standards and Methods  Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model.  Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites.  Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined.  Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow.  2. Quality and Continuous Improvement  Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations.  Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality.  Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing.  Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites.  3. Operations Performance  Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle.  Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps.  Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites.  Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis.  4. International Coordination and Deployment  Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites.  Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking.  Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites.  Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up.  Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard.  5. Product and Industrialization Interface  Work with the Product Manager to translate product and vehicle evolution into operational process requirements.  Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality.  Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives.  Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment.  6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution  Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager.  Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse.  Support POQs and improvement initiatives that can be standardized and deployed across the four sites.  Provide operational feedback on automation, digitalization and Data Factory initiatives.  7. Team Capability, Safety and Governance  Train and coach teams on standard work, quality requirements and safe operating practices.  Develop competency assessments and practical onboarding for critical Autoreverse activities.  Identify process, quality and safety risks and coordinate mitigation actions.  Maintain clear documentation and ensure that process changes are communicated and implemented.  Requirements QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS  Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations management or a related discipline.  Professional background: Approximately 5 years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, industrial operations, quality or process improvement.  Experience in a hands-on production, workshop, laboratory or technical operating environment.  Experience with quality tools, process audits, structured problem solving and corrective action plans.  Experience coordinating improvement activities across several teams or sites is preferred.  International exposure: Experience working with multicultural teams or across multiple operating locations.  Lean, Six Sigma, quality or project management certification is an advantage.  SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES  Hands-on operational leadership in an industrial or technical environment.  Strong quality and continuous improvement mindset, with practical root-cause and corrective-action experience.  Ability to standardize processes and deploy them consistently across multiple sites.  Analytical approach to KPIs, process performance and operational problem solving.  Ability to work effectively with Operations Managers, Product, Quality and technical teams.  Structured, pragmatic and able to influence without relying only on formal authority.  Professional English; French or another A2MAC1 operating language is an advantage.  Benefits Meal vouchers Holiday bonus Employee profit-sharing bonus Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Chargé.e de communication marketing
raw.description:
Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires.

Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action.

C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation.

Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique.

Entreprise lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens.

Vos missions

En lien direct avec le responsable marketing et communication, vous participerez à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de communication de l'entreprise afin de renforcer sa notoriété, valoriser son offre et engager ses différentes cibles (B2B, secteurs privé et public).

Création de contenus audiovisuels

  • Concevoir, tourner et monter des vidéos : présentations produit, témoignages clients, interviews d'experts, formats courts pour les réseaux sociaux,

  • Réaliser des visuels et supports graphiques en cohérence avec la charte de l'entreprise,

  • Participer à la captation de contenus lors d'événements, de webinaires ou de salons,

  • Adapter les contenus aux différents canaux (sous-titrage, déclinaisons de formats, miniatures).

Rédaction & production de contenus

  • Rédiger des contenus variés : articles de blog, actualités, newsletters, cas clients, communiqués de presse,

  • Adapter le ton et le niveau de langage aux cibles (décideurs, techniciens, collectivités, partenaires),

  • Contribuer à la création de supports marketing : plaquettes, présentations, fiches produit, emailings.

Animation des réseaux sociaux

  • Participation au développement des comptes de l'entreprise (LinkedIn et YouTube),

  • Rédiger et programmer les publications, en adaptant le ton et le format à chaque plateforme,

  • Animer la communauté : veille, interactions, relais des actualités de l'entreprise et de ses collaborateurs,

  • Proposer des formats innovants pour accroître l'engagement (carrousels, vidéos courtes, témoignages, séries thématiques).

Gestion du site web (WordPress)

  • Mettre en ligne et mettre à jour les contenus sur le site : pages, articles, actualités, visuels, vidéos,

  • Veiller à la cohérence éditoriale et graphique ainsi qu'à la qualité des contenus publiés,

  • Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de base (SEO, poids des images, accessibilité, liens).

Événementiel & communication corporate

  • Participer à l'organisation et à la promotion des événements (salons, webinaires, conférences),

  • Contribuer à la communication interne et à la valorisation de la marque employeur,

  • Assurer une veille sur les tendances de communication et les actions des concurrents.

Suivi de performance & amélioration continue

  • Suivre les indicateurs clés (engagement, audience, trafic, taux d'ouverture…) via des outils type LinkedIn Analytics, GA4, outils d'emailing,

  • Réaliser des reportings réguliers et proposer des axes d'optimisation,

  • Participer à l'élaboration et au suivi du calendrier éditorial.

Vos compétences

Vous préparez une formation en communication, marketing, audiovisuel, journalisme ou équivalent (Bac+4 / Bac+5) et souhaitez développer vos compétences sur l'ensemble des leviers de la communication et du marketing.

Vous avez une plume claire et efficace, un bon sens visuel et aimez raconter des histoires, à l'écrit comme en vidéo. Vous savez adapter un message à une cible et à un canal, et transformer un sujet technique en contenu accessible et engageant.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les réseaux sociaux et avez déjà manipulé des outils de montage vidéo et de création graphique.

Vous êtes rigoureux·se, organisé·e, créatif·ve, curieux·se, et appréciez le travail en équipe : prendre du feedback, itérer rapidement et respecter des délais.

Un plus : compétences en tournage (cadrage, lumière, son), portfolio de réalisations (vidéos, visuels, publications), projets personnels en lien avec la communication, première expérience en communication B2B ou dans le secteur de la transition énergétique.

Compétences clés

  • Excellente qualité rédactionnelle : orthographe, grammaire, style clair, capacité à vulgariser et à adapter son ton,

  • Maîtrise du montage vidéo (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve ou équivalent),

  • Compétences audiovisuelles appréciées : tournage, prise de son, vidéo mobile,

  • Bonne connaissance des réseaux sociaux, de leurs codes et de leurs formats,

  • Connaissance de WordPress et des bases du SEO,

  • Aisance avec les outils de création graphique (Canva, suite Adobe…) et Microsoft Office,

  • Maîtrise des outils IA appliqués à la création de contenus,

  • Rigueur et organisation : gestion de plusieurs projets en parallèle, respect des délais, relecture systématique,

  • Esprit d'équipe : intégrer les retours, travailler avec les équipes marketing, commerciales et experts métiers,

  • Autonomie progressive et force de proposition : capacité à proposer des idées, des formats et des angles de communication.

Avantages

  • Localisation : Quartier de la Part-Dieu, au cœur de Lyon,

  • Un environnement de travail dynamique,

  • Gratification : selon année d'étude,

  • Remboursement à 50 % des transports en commun,

  • Tickets restaurant de 10 € par jour,

  • Télétravail partiel possible après une période d'intégration.

Informations complémentaires

  • Type de contrat : Stage de 6 mois (offre non ouverte à l'alternance)

  • Date de début : dès que possible

Pour candidater, merci d'envoyer votre CV ainsi qu'une courte lettre de motivation. Démarquez-vous en partageant un book ou des exemples de réalisations !

raw.description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your Mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which the sales team has tripled in size and increased ARR per sales rep by 50% (from €400K to €600K).

To achieve this, you own Business & Revenue Operations end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Ops, Finance and Product. You report to Robin, Head of RevOps, and work hand in hand with the Head of Sales, your main internal client.

Beyond the revenue engine, you are the go-to partner of leadership on revenue decisions: segmentation and targeting, pricing, sales capacity planning, and the operational setup of our US expansion. You turn ambiguous questions into structured, data-backed recommendations, then you build the solution yourself.

This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role. You define the strategy, build, run, document and iterate.

Responsibilities

Sales & GTM Ops

  • Own the CRM (Attio): pipeline structure, stages, fields, hygiene

  • Define and track funnel metrics (SQL, win rate, cycle length, ARR)

  • Build deal workflows, pricing logic and approvals

  • Support sales with clean data, dashboards and forecasts

  • Instrument meetings, calls, emails and demos in the CRM

  • Define activity standards, ensure data completeness, provide visibility on activity vs results

  • Implement compensation rules as the single source of truth; automate calculations, reporting and payout exports; make sure numbers are clear, trusted and undisputed

  • Own the sales tool stack (demo platform, telephony, call recording, integrations): reliability, adoption and proper usage across the team

Onboarding & Delivery Ops

  • Structure deployment workflows (from signed deal to live)

  • Track time-to-live, blockers and handoffs

  • Standardize configs, templates and playbooks

Billing & Revenue

  • Own the contracts → billing → cash collection flow

  • Work with tools like Hyperline, Stripe and invoicing

  • Track MRR, ARR, churn, expansion and cohorts

  • Ensure pricing is applied correctly (per site, per provider, per call)

Revenue Analytics & Strategic Projects

  • Build weekly and monthly revenue dashboards

  • Track unit economics (ARPA, gross margin, CAC, LTV)

  • Lead ad hoc analyses for leadership: market segmentation, territory design, pricing, capacity planning

  • Surface issues early. No surprises.

Process & Documentation

  • Write everything down (Notion)

  • Create SOPs so the company doesn’t rely on tribal knowledge

  • Make the org scalable from [25] to 100+ people

 

This role is for you if

  • 3–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

  • Fluent in French, Professional English

 

Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Recruitment process

1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • More than 1,000 medical staff use our product all day

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

What you will own

  • The scenario engine and its configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp.

  • The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Internal tooling already took a clinic deployment from days to under an hour. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding.

  • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and follow a design system written in code.

  • Your features, end to end. From the spec with the ops team to production, and the fix when something breaks, with the reason it does not happen again.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 3 to 8 years building full-stack products in production, in startups that were growing fast.

  • You stayed long enough somewhere to see a system live, break and get better, and you learned from it.

  • TypeScript is your main language, backend and frontend, not a line on your CV. You have a real eye for interface quality and the discipline to follow a design system.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code, and you know how to build systems that hold when the volume explodes.

  • You move without waiting for a perfect frame: you try, you propose, you ship. You ask for help when you are stuck.

  • You had good practices before AI: solid system design, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

Probably not for you if you need every feature fully specified before you start

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first improvement on the dashboard is in production.

  • First month. You own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production, without mockups or hand-holding.

  • First 3 months. The first version of the scenario engine is in production. A standard clinic can be onboarded without a developer ticket.

  • 6 to 12 months. Most new clinics are live within 7 days. Clinics configure their own rules in the dashboard.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about product architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.
