title: Head of Search (Paid+SEO/GEO)
description: 🎯 Ton objectif : Prendre la tête du pôle Search tout juste unifié (Paid, SEO et GEO) et en faire le premier moteur de croissance rentable de l'entreprise, avec un budget paid media annuel à 8 chiffres. En 5 hashtags , ça donne 👉 #PaidSearch #SEA #SEO #GEO #tROAS 🍒 sur le 🎂 : tu arrives au moment où tout se construit. Les équipes Paid et SEO viennent d'être fusionnées pour sortir du silo par canal, le projet tROAS est relancé en priorité avec tout un chapitre à écrire, et la roadmap IA / LLM / GEO est à bâtir de zéro, avec des outils IA internes déjà interfacés avec l'écosystème technique. 🚀 Tes missions principales : Définir et porter une vision Search unifiée (SEA, SEO et GEO) et la roadmap qui va avec, pour maximiser la valeur globale plutôt que la performance de chaque canal pris isolément. Piloter le Paid Search au quotidien avec une vraie responsabilité business : revenu, ROAS, CAC, rentabilité, avec un suivi rigoureux des parts de visibilité face à la concurrence. Mener le projet tROAS : fiabilisation du tracking, objectifs de ROAS par produit et par segment, enchères basées sur la valeur, test & learn structuré. Arbitrer les investissements selon leur valeur incrémentale, et piloter la cannibalisation entre paid, SEO, direct et marque. Accélérer le plan de reconquête SEO engagé, pour retrouver le leadership organique sur le marché. Construire la visibilité de la marque dans les moteurs IA (Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) et la mesure qui va avec : présence, citations, part de voix. Faire de l'IA et de l'automatisation un réflexe dans l'équipe, pour en finir avec les tâches faites à la main. Rassurer et embarquer : reporting régulier auprès de la direction générale et du groupe, en anglais. Manager et faire monter en compétences ton équipe de 4 personnes en direct et 3 en indirect. 💛 Ton équipe : L'entreprise : un comparateur digital dans les secteurs de l’assurance et des services financiers, créé il y a 14 ans et réunissant une centaine de personnes à son siège parisien. En forte croissance, sa culture est tech, rapide et collaborative. Ton équipe : 7 personnes de qualité, volontaires et agréables au quotidien. Côté SEO, tu manages en direct 3 chef·fes de projet répartis par typologie de produits, dont un profil senior référent IA de l'équipe. Côté Paid, tu manages le Head of Paid Acquisition, qui encadre 2 traffic managers et une responsable acquisition médias digitaux et partenariats. Ton manager : le CMO : très humain et motivant pour ses équipes, c’est un véritable manager-mentor : il accompagne la progression de chacun·e et donne les moyens de réussir. Tes interlocuteurs : tu évolues au sein d’une équipe marketing d’une trentaine de personnes, avec des expertises clés en CRM, branding, contenus et service client. Tu collabores également avec les équipes data, produit et tech, ainsi qu’avec tes homologues à l’international. 💻 Tes Conditions de travail : Ton bureau : de très beaux bureaux, hyper agréables, dans le 17ème arrondissement de Paris, à côté du Parc Monceau. Le midi : pas de cantine, mais une carte tickets restaurant. Ton package de rémunération : Salaire fixe : entre 80 et 95k€ brut annuels, selon expérience. Salaire variable : jusqu’à 5% de ton salaire fixe par an Participation/Intéressement : Participation jusqu'à 10% du salaire annuel selon les objectifs d'entreprise (rentabilité, marge), soit jusqu’à 9k€/an + Intéressement. Autres avantages : très bonne mutuelle, prime annuelle de vacances (environ 800€ cette année), primes culture et sport, soirées au minimum une fois par mois. Ton rythme : 5 semaines de congés payés Une dizaine de jours de RTT par an. Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine (et encore plus de souplesse sur juillet/août). Possibilité de semaine en full-remote durant les fêtes de fin d’année. Tes expériences & compétences : Tu es un·e expert·e du Paid Search, et ça se voit dans le détail : Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Brave, Smart Bidding, tROAS / tCPA, value-based bidding, Performance Max n'ont aucun secret pour toi. Tu as piloté des budgets d'acquisition importants et un P&L, avec une responsabilité directe sur le ROAS, le CAC et l'incrémentalité. Tu as l'habitude des organisations où le reporting est soutenu, y compris auprès d'une direction générale ou d'un groupe. Tu as une solide culture SEO : sans forcément être un·e expert·e technique, tu sais définir une stratégie, challenger tes experts et piloter le levier. Tu as une forte appétence pour l'IA et le GEO, et idéalement tu as déjà mené tes premières expérimentations concrètes. Tu as plusieurs années de management derrière toi, idéalement de profils seniors ou de managers. Tu parles anglais couramment, c'est indispensable pour travailler avec le groupe. Un passage en agence serait un vrai plus, notamment pour l'accès aux bêta-tests et la culture de l'innovation. Une expérience en comparateur, marketplace, assurance ou services financiers serait appréciée. Ta personnalité : Business avant tout, tu relies chaque choix Search à la croissance, au revenu incrémental et à la rentabilité. Rigoureux·se et pointu·e, tu pilotes au quotidien, tu anticipes et tu sais que la performance se joue souvent dans le détail. Leader et pédagogue, tu tires une équipe vers le haut, y compris des profils qui s'y connaissent déjà, en donnant un cap clair sans tomber dans le micromanagement. Curieux·se et pragmatique, tu testes vite les nouveautés IA et tu ne gardes que ce qui crée de la valeur. Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job : C'est un poste pour quelqu'un qui veut bâtir un pôle et pas juste reprendre un périmètre. Le Search est le plus gros levier de croissance de la boîte, les moyens sont là (budget paid >10M€/an) et la fusion SEA/SEO/GEO est encore à orchestrer. Si tu es un·e pro du paid qui rêve d'avoir enfin la main sur toute la chaîne Search, avec l'IA en terrain de jeu, tu es au bon endroit ! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

You run day-to-day security operations for a full-cloud company as a senior engineer in the SecOps team, reporting to the SecOps Manager. You bring technical proposals to the SecOps Manager; the IT & Security lead approves the SecOps roadmap. 

You back up the SecOps Manager on technical topics and during incidents. 

You are also the link between SecOps and the other teams, mainly R&D, Platform Engineering and IT. You keep them in sync on security priorities, changes and incidents. You train them on secure practices and on the security tooling they use, so they can own security in their own areas.

Most of your time goes into building and running things yourself. You write the Terraform, the detections and the automation.


Responsibilities

  • GCP guardrails and posture as code: definition, organization policies, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, KMS and Secret Manager; run our CSPM (Wiz); take controls from monitoring to enforcement with a rollback plan; deliver controls in Terraform and CI/CD policy checks with Platform Engineering.

  • Detection and incident response: own log pipelines (Cloud Logging, audit logs, Workspace, Okta, CrowdStrike), build detections end to end (log onboarding, SIEM use cases, validation) and manage alert quality, automating triage and enrichment; lead security incidents from triage to root cause and post-mortem, including GCP forensics; maintain playbooks and run tabletop exercises.

  • Vulnerability and attack-surface management: cloud, containers (GKE, Artifact Registry), dependencies and external surface; prioritize findings on exploitability and real exposure; run the technical side of external pentests (scoping, challenging findings, retest) and drive remediation with owning teams and track SLAs.

  • Secure development: threat-model new services with R&D; embed SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning and supply-chain controls in the SDLC; be the security contact for each R&D team.

  • Assurance: produce technical evidence for ISO 27001 audits; answer the technical part of customer security questionnaires and RFPs, including non-standard requests; assess the security of third-party vendors.

  • FinOps: know the cost of the security tooling you deploy, flag cost drifts early and work with Procurement on cost estimates when selecting security vendors.


    • Must-have profile

  • 7+ years in security engineering or SecOps, including 3+ years securing production on a public cloud — GCP strongly preferred, AWS/Azure transferable.

  • Deep GCP security knowledge: IAM model, org policies, VPC-SC, SCC, logging, GKE security.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native security platforms such as Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center (SCC) and Wiz (or similar CNAPPs).

  • Hands-on incident response experience, including leading incidents and cloud forensics.

  • Detection engineering with a SIEM and log pipelines at scale.

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and scripting.

  • Clear written and spoken English and French; able to explain risk to engineers and to customers.

  • Skills in project management

  • Proactive, bring forward proposals and make recommendations

  • Kubernetes / GKE hardening and runtime security.

  • Experience in ad tech or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive platforms.

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the operations side.

  • Identity and endpoint stack: Okta, Google Workspace, CrowdStrike.

80% bis 100% - Arbeitsort Sissach, Oensingen, Schafisheim

  • Du unterstützt und begleitest unsere Projektleitenden bei komplexen Ausbau- und Erhaltungsprojekten des ASTRA im Bereich IT/OT-Systemtechnik und bildest die Schnittstelle zu internen und externen Stakeholdern.

As Technical Founders Associate in our office in Zurich, you'll be the right hand of our CTO, Max. You run the daily business of the CTO office, own strategic projects from start to finish, drive the first round of our technical hiring, and bridge technology and business. This is a true zero-to-one mandate.
Whether you come from computer science or business, you combine strong tech understanding with real commercial thinking. You won't be writing production code, but you'll understand our product and infrastructure well, be a trusted counterpart for our engineers, and know what technical decisions mean for the business.

What You'll Do

  • CTO Office & Executive Support

    • Manage our CTO's priorities so his time goes to what matters most

    • Prepare briefing documents and agendas for important meetings and make sure every action item gets followed up

  • Technical Hiring

    • Run first-round calls with engineering candidates and coordinate the interview process with our team

  • Strategic Projects

    • Take full ownership of critical projects, from deep dives into emerging tech trends to board-level material

    • Evaluate and drive strategic technical partnerships that keep us at the forefront of AI infrastructure

  • Tech x Business

    • Translate technical topics into commercial decisions and clear stories for customers, partners and investors

    • Support pricing, product and go-to-market questions with a technical angle

    • Build the processes the CTO office and engineering team need to scale

What We're Looking For

  • Studies (preferably Master level) or a degree in computer science or a related technical field, OR in business, economics or management with a strong understanding of technology

  • Very good commercial understanding: you think in business impact, not just technology

  • Real curiosity for tech: you can follow and discuss AI and infrastructure topics with engineers

  • First practical experience in a fast-paced environment such as a startup, consulting or VC

  • Builder's mindset: you take high ownership and enjoy building processes from scratch

  • Hustle & execution: you're pragmatic and move fast without losing sight of quality – a "get shit done" mentality is essential

  • Organizational talent: you stay calm under pressure and work in a highly structured and precise way

  • Communication: excellent written and verbal English, German is a plus

Bonus Points

  • Exposure to AI, cloud or GPU infrastructure

  • You've built something yourself: a side project, student initiative or venture

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Switzerland. We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment. You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses. Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms. The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support. You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions. Accountabilities Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses. Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows. Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog. Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility. Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON. Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Apply Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices to manage development, testing, deployment and promotion of data solutions across environments. Work closely with data analysts, reporting teams and software developers to understand business requirements and deliver appropriate technical solutions. Maintain clear technical documentation and contribute to collaborative Agile delivery. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. At least 8 years of professional IT experience, including 4 or more years in Data Engineering or ETL Development. Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including: PySpark and Spark SQL. Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. Databricks Workflows and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines. Advanced SQL skills, including T-SQL and Spark SQL, with experience in Microsoft SQL Server, dimensional modelling and data warehousing. Solid Python programming and scripting skills for data transformation, automation and pipeline development. Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and data formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON, as well as ingestion from APIs and files. Practical knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD, including automated testing and deployment processes. Strong understanding of data integration, ETL development, data quality and production troubleshooting. Ability to interpret complex business requirements, communicate technical solutions clearly and produce comprehensive documentation. Strong organisational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in an Agile environment. Fluent English and availability for occasional travel at the beginning of the project and when required. Must be based in Europe and have the legal right to work in Europe, as work permit sponsorship is not provided. Nice to have: Experience with Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow or Azure Functions for orchestration and event-driven processing. Knowledge of dbt, PowerShell, .NET or Java. Experience integrating data from SharePoint and Microsoft Graph. Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, data governance, observability, Infrastructure as Code and data lineage. Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot to improve development productivity. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement for candidates based in Europe. Full-time opportunity within a modern cloud data engineering environment. Opportunity to work with a broad Azure data technology stack, including Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake and enterprise data warehousing. Exposure to modern data engineering practices, automation, CI/CD and data governance. Collaboration with technical and business stakeholders on meaningful enterprise data solutions. Occasional project-related travel, with availability required at the start of the engagement and when needed.   • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page Audit Senior Specialist About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/ About the role You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one. This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees. You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way. You'll be responsible for Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees. Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks. Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks. Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks. Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting. Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence. Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring. Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards. Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity. We are looking for a person who has Experience and background A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience. Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework. Meaningful experience in fintech or banking. Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees. Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure. Ways of working and skills High ownership and autonomy A genuinely hands-on posture A builder mindset A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential. Cultural openness and humility Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile. Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives. Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense. German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required. Nice to have Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement) No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).   • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager. In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s. Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers. Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Wat bieden wij?  Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450.  8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering; Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage; Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist; Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen; Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage; Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken; Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage; Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt. Over de organisatie Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)! title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
description: Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof. This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs. The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate. What you will do Customer lifecycle marketing Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion. Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences. Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes. Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals. Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives. Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns. Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths. Customer advocacy and proof Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate. Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events. Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams. Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition. Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities. Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria. Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up. Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives. Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets. Program operations and measurement Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution. Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting. Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue. Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution. Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale. What you bring 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline. Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy. A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities. Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders. Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations. Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets. Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically. Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus. Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus. Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus. How success is measured Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion. Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation. Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation. Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion. Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity. Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria. Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction. Je installeert en onderhoudt beveiligingssystemen zoals camera’s en toegangscontrole. Op locatie pak jij de leiding: je stuurt collega’s aan, houdt overzicht en zorgt dat het werk goed en op tijd wordt opgeleverd!

Onze Hoofd Monteur Beveiligingstechniek schakelt met klanten en je collega’s van kantoor, denkt mee in oplossingen en zorgt dat systemen optimaal draaien.

Je vertrekt grotendeels van huis uit en werkt in schone omgevingen.

Word jij gelukkig van projecten in de kost? Soms hebben wij projecten met een grote reisafstand. Als Hoofd Monteur Beveiligingstechniek werk je dan 4 dagen op locatie en ben je de 5de dag vrij.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Een sterk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket dat past bij een ervaren monteur met verantwoordelijkheid!

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen

  • Goede pensioenregeling (Pensioenopbouw via PMT)

  • Product trainingen via leveranciers om je kennis te vergroten

  • Passend vervoer, laptop en een netto telefoonvergoeding van € 50,- per maand

  • Inspirerende teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrels en een jaarlijks familiefeest (Phantasialand in 2026)

  • Toegang tot de diverse VDK Groep voordelen met kortingen op verzekeringen, verzekeringen, brandstof, attracties, bekende merken, fietsregeling en nog veel meer! 

  • Indien interesse in incidentele projecten in de kost;

    • Je werkt 4 dagen in de kost op locatie in Duitsland of België

    • Je bent vrij op de 5de dag (vrijdag)

    • Hotel en eten wordt verzorgd

    • Je ontvangt een bruto overnachtingsvergoeding van € 100,-

Wat ga je doen

Als Senior Monteur Beveiligingstechniek werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je installeert, begeleid en draagt zorg aan systemen om betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig te blijven.

  • Uitvoeren en coördineren van beveiligingsprojecten (CCTV, toegangscontrole en inbraak)

  • Bewaken van de voortgang van project en afstemmen met opdrachtgevers

  • Onderhouden van contact en samenwerking met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers en collega’s

  • Coachen en begeleiden van collega’s op locatie

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatieprojecten op locatie.

  • Signaleren en doorvoeren van verbeteringen

  • Uitvoeren van preventief en periodiek onderhoud

 

 Wat neem je mee

  • Opleiding in elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar

  • Ervaring in beveiligingstechniek is een pré

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en overzicht houden op projecten

  • Technisch inzicht en probleemoplossend vermogen

  • Proactieve houding en initiatief

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Rijbewijs B en Verklaring van Betrouwbaarheid

Dus heb je al ervaring als hoofd monteur, eerste monteur, teamleider, meewerkend voorman, of Leidinggevend monteur?

Dan staat de koffie klaar!

 

Highlights

  • Standplaats: Assendelft, Noord-Holland, Nederland

  • Regio: Projecten Landelijk (vertrekkend van huis, rekening houdend met jouw woonplaats) Incidenteel in Duitsland en België.

  • Team: technisch team met monteurs en projectleiding

  • Projecttype: beveiligingssystemen binnen diverse omgevingen

  • Werkomgeving: Schoon, professioneel, innovatief en oplossingsgericht

 

Shield Beveiligingstechniek & VDK Groep

 Shield Beveiligingstechniek is specialist in beveiligingsoplossingen en werkt aan projecten waarbij kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en innovatie centraal staan. Je werkt met moderne technieken en systemen op verschillende locaties in schone omgevingen waar initiatief en vakmanschap worden gewaardeerd. Het is een platte organisatie met weinig personeelsverloop.

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep, maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Je voelt je thuis bij Shield Beveiligingstechniek, terwijl je kunt bouwen op de kracht van de VDK Groep. Dit betekent; Extra voordelen zoals stabiliteit, volop opleidingskansen, doorgroeimogelijkheden en veel extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden! De VDK Groep is medio April 2026 zo’n 180 bedrijven en ruim 7000 medewerkers groot en gevestigd in 6 Europese landen.

title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights. You bring: willingness to learn around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller; solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics); experience with or a strong interest in Power BI; strong analytical skills; the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models; a curious and proactive approach to solving problems; the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working; an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve; a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data; fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable. experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What we offer This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used. You can expect: a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience. an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary;  full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave;  a pension scheme;  a commuting allowance;  a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop; structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. title: HR-Stagiair(e)
description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen. Jouw stage: Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Waar draag je aan bij? Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten. Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie. De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie). Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties. Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen. Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een stagiair(e) die: Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027. Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen. Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt. Wij bieden: Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week. Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals. Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur. Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s. Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd! Over Benchmark Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd. Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s. Interesse? Benchmark wil vooruit, samen met jou als HR-Stagiair(e)! Ben je op zoek naar meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Stan Broenink via Het verstrekken van een VOG is een vast onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure bij Benchmark. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. title: Junior Data Consultant
description: Onze Missie LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen. Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data.  Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen.  Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data.  Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren.  Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI.    Team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. title: Android Engineer
description: Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team. What You'll Build & Own On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end. Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe. Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions. Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it. AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship. What You Bring Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns. Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end. AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role. ✨ Why join us? 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance) 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success. 🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches 🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics. 📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter. 🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back. 🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync. 💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too. 🎵 What kind of vibe can you expect at our office? Check out our very own Spotify playlist " Akwablues " 🎬 Curious about our story & culture? Check our documentaries on Youtube ! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Director within our Corporate, Issues &amp; Crisis team, you will be a senior strategic advisor and team leader – protecting and enhancing the reputations of some of the world’s most significant organisations. Based in Amsterdam, you’ll lead high-stakes issues and crisis work across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, counselling senior clients through their most sensitive moments and delivering media training that builds their confidence and capability. You’ll grow existing relationships, win new business, and help build the visibility, reputation and talent of the team in the Netherlands.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take a leading role in developing Burson’s corporate, issues and crisis work in the Netherlands – retaining existing clients and growing new business</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor and senior counsel to clients, adding strategic value during sensitive, high-stakes and reputational moments</li> <li>Lead issues and crisis programmes for clients across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, anticipating risks and building proactive response plans</li> <li>Design and deliver media training and crisis simulation exercises that build client confidence and capability</li> <li>Build the visibility and reputation of the team – with a view to winning new business and attracting talent</li> <li>Manage and mentor client teams, nurturing talent and contributing to a strong, collaborative team culture across the agency</li> <li>Take responsibility for budget monitoring, revenue forecasting, resourcing and fee negotiation to ensure the correct level of profitability</li> <li>Represent Burson externally in relevant specialist forums, network groups and speaker platforms across the Dutch and EU market</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven background leading corporate, issues and crisis management within both agency and in-house settings, with strong exposure to complex, high-stakes scenarios and strategic media relations.</li> <li>Sector expertise across either Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology with a strong understanding of the issues shaping these industries</li> <li>Experienced in designing and delivering media training and crisis simulation exercises, alongside wider reputation management initiatives</li> <li>Skilled in managing communications across a broad range of stakeholders – including media, government, employees, investors and consumers – during sensitive, high-pressure moments</li> <li>Commercially driven and entrepreneurial, with a track record of independently identifying and converting new business and managing client relationships end-to-end</li> <li>Trusted advisor to senior communications leaders and C-suite executives, with excellent interpersonal skills and credibility at the highest levels</li> <li>A strong, collaborative team leader, experienced in resourcing, commercial oversight and building high-performing, resilient teams, with previous experience within both agency and client-side environments.</li> <li>Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the confidence to counsel clients and present in both languages</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Director, Head of Quality <span style="font-size: inherit;">&amp; Responsible Person</span> for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity&nbsp;</li> <li>Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management</li> <li>Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations</li> <li>Approve return to saleable stock</li> <li>Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment</li> <li>Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup</li> <li>Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license</li> <li>Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program</li> <li>Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces&nbsp;</li> <li>Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements</li> <li>Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP</li> <li>Participate in GDP vendor qualification program</li> <li>Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications</li> <li>Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation&nbsp;</li> <li>Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets</li> <li>Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence</li> <li>Be available and reachable 24/7&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed</li> <li>Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements</li> <li>Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective</li> <li>Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed&nbsp;</li> <li>Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in regulatory inspections&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in internal and external project team meetings&nbsp;</li> <li>Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Other duties as assigned&nbsp;</li> description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between. Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service. What you’ll be doing: Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included) Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email. Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager) What you’ll be bringing to the team: Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows Even better if you have, but not necessary: Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry Experience supporting a SaaS product Experience supporting an iOS application Computer networking experience or interest Even better if you have, but not necessary Passion in technology; Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS; Hospitality experience; French written and verbal communication skills; We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions.
