raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Infra Platform Group
raw.description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Infra Platform Group, where you'll play a key role in scaling core infrastructure, empowering product engineering teams, and driving technical strategy.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager of the Infra Platform Group, you will manage two Haskell/Rust teams (Infra Blue and Infra Red) and one Python team (Python Infrastructure and Performance - PIP). The group consists of three team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~12 individual contributors in total.

These teams work on Channable’s core infrastructure, including services such as a data processing engine and a job scheduler. While scaling our applications to handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput with high speed and responsiveness is key, the work goes far beyond performance. You will focus on building new capabilities for product engineering teams, making their lives easier by delivering unified technical solutions across product groups, foreseeing infrastructure challenges, and collaborating directly with product engineering teams and the CTO to align initiatives with company strategy.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the technical roadmap by balancing the work on scaling and performance with feature requests from the product teams

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Maintain a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • Oversee and improve the hiring process for platform engineers

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account

💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • Ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team while managing performance and professional development

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • You are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • You are collaborative, empowering, and adaptable - ready to take on challenges and contribute to strategic decision-making

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Ansible, Terraform, React, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.


Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Note: The official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou. Dit ga je doen Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen. Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties. Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001. Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken. Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy. De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Je kunt beleid en risico’s vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Tegelijkertijd heb je de ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn ook meer strategische verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Daarbij neem je mee: Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau; bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van securitymanagement, bestuurskunde of bedrijfskunde. Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring en relevante ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en/of privacy. Kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en normenkaders, zoals de AVG, BIO, ABRO, NIS2, NEN7510 en ISO 27001. Het vermogen om risico’s en beleid te vertalen naar concrete, werkbare maatregelen en acties. Een praktische en zelfstandige houding: je adviseert, organiseert én pakt zelf zaken op. Sterk analytisch vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatiesensitiviteit, waardoor je collega’s kunt meenemen en verschillende belangen bij elkaar kunt brengen. Certificeringen als CISSP, CISM, CISA, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPM en CDPO zijn een pré, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker vinden we dat je de inhoudelijke basis en motivatie hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. title: Data Analyst - Logistics
description: Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data. What you get  A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience.  €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.  25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.  Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.  €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.  A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then.  Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.  About us  All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.    What the job looks like  Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. What you bring  Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told. Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too. Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job. Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time. Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge . You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards. AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus. Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus. Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.   We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.  Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess. raw.description:
This is a fully remote ongoing freelance only position.  You will hear directly from our Talent Acquisition team once we have an update for you regarding your application status.

We are looking for experienced and multi-talented freelance Senior Systems Designer. This is an exciting opportunity to work on a major AAA titles with a team of passionate and highly experienced designers where you will be responsible for some of the game’s moment-to-moment gameplay mechanics and systems. Ideally you will have experience of creating incredible gameplay on other AAA games and being responsible for owning them from start to finish.

Requirements

  • Experience working as a Gameplay Systems Designer creating gameplay features and mechanics on at least one published AAA console title.
  • Proven experience working within Unreal Engine 4 or 5, as well as with Blueprinting.
  • Experience with working on player movement, abilities and weapons, cameras, and exploration mechanics.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype ideas in engine.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with a creative & multi-disciplinary team.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Enjoys a creative challenge with the passion and motivation to drive features forward and make great gameplay.
  • Experience of third-person level design and encounter design is a benefit.

Responsibilities

  • Create and take ownership of core gameplay systems.
  • Work closely with the team and all stakeholders collaboratively throughout the game’s development.
  • Create compelling and memorable moment to moment gameplay.
  • Create and maintain clear and concise documentation for all the features you are responsible for.
  • Keep to project vision for best practices, methodologies used and quality benchmark.
  • As part of level reviews, able to accept critique and come up with solutions.
  • Regularly play the game and provide suggestions and feedback in a clear and constructive manner.
  • Ability to self-motivate as well as working well as part of a team.
